purpose: Carry result-landing contracts for raw-seed automatic operations that produce preview, projection, proposal, coverage, bridge, or shard artifacts while preserving raw_seed_metabolism as the authority boundary and system/lib/launchable_operations.py as the command allowlist authority.

raw_seed_metabolism_owns: raw-seed review and proposal artifact semantics
raw-seed coverage and routing-review surface meanings

migration_rule: Keep only raw-seed projection, preview, bridge, shard, coverage, and proposal landing metadata here. Do not use this file to authorize source promotion, doctrine mutation, WorkItem ranking, or arbitrary launchable-operation contracts.

residual_routing.primary: raw_seed_routing_review.json proposal queue, raw_seed_coverage.json freshness counts, extracted_shards.json routing state, and metabolism job/run receipt
residual_routing.stale_or_failed: Task Ledger note/capture under cap_quick_launchable_operations_landing_surface_contract when route-review exits nonzero, writes no routing review, coverage remains stale, selected shards stay unrouted, or promotion review is pending too long
residual_routing.promotion_boundary: raw_seed_apply_loop.py apply-routing or surface-to-codex must approve before any raw_seed.md, raw_seed.json, doctrine, source, or WorkItem mutation

result_landing_contract.produces: Bounded doctrine-routing review proposals and coverage updates for atomized raw-seed shards; preview/review artifacts only.
result_landing_contract.success_signal: raw_seed_pipeline.py route-review exits 0 and returns raw_seed_routing_review_path plus raw_seed_coverage_path; routing review/coverage artifacts are written with proposal and routing-state counts.
result_landing_contract.residual_signal: route-review exits nonzero, provider wave-width policy rejects the run, routing review/coverage artifacts are missing or stale, selected shards remain pending without proposal explanation, or the review queue awaits apply/surface promotion.

residual_routing.primary: raw_seed_bridge_distillation run root with run_summary.json and bridge_receipt.json; successful imports append validated shards to extracted_shards.json and refresh raw_seed_coverage.json
residual_routing.failure_contract: A zero-import bridge run is not silent completion. bridge_receipt.json must classify artifact_missing, bridge_rows_quarantined, importer_dedupe_zero, provider_safety_refusal, local_process_killed, unknown_worker_error, or another std_bridge_failure_class value before the launch contract is considered durable.
residual_routing.stale_or_failed: Task Ledger note/capture under cap_quick_launchable_operations_landing_surface_contract when bridge_receipt.classified_outcome is false, failure_class repeats without remediation, expected bridge artifacts are missing, or selected paragraphs remain pending after retry budget.
residual_routing.promotion_boundary: Distill-cycle may write bridge packets, observe dumps, bridge receipts, extracted_shards.json imports, and coverage projections. raw_seed.md, raw_seed.json, doctrine, source, and WorkItem mutation remain behind raw_seed_apply_loop.py or another controller-owned apply/review lane.

result_landing_contract.produces: A bounded bridge-first raw-seed distillation run: paragraph packets, provider/bridge observe outputs, a bridge_receipt classification, run_summary, and optionally validated extracted shard imports plus coverage refresh.
result_landing_contract.success_signal: bridge_receipt.status is ok, partial, or noop with classified_outcome=true; operation-level useful success requires import_count>0 or noop. A classified failed receipt is durable failure evidence, not semantic completion.
result_landing_contract.residual_signal: bridge_receipt.status=failed, failure_class is not none/noop, import_count=0 with artifact_missing or quarantine-only outcome, classified_outcome=false, local filename/path errors before receipt persistence, missing observe artifacts, or repeated provider/runtime failure without owner-visible remediation.

condition.message: Contract coverage is complete, but historical runtime evidence is failure-heavy; classified bridge failures are durable residual evidence, not semantic success.
